name: Entering Manastorm sends the starter items' query responses with the grant
contract: Entering Manastorm grants Endless Manastorm Potion (254041), Millhouse's Regeneration Matrix (97895) and Millhouse's Magical Escape (254042) and starts the far teleport in the same update. The client's CMSG_ITEM_QUERY_SINGLE for the new items reaches the server while the player is out of the world; STATUS_LOGGEDIN packets are dropped then, so the tooltips stay at 'Retrieving item information'.

The server must send SMSG_ITEM_QUERY_SINGLE_RESPONSE (0x058) for every starter item it grants. The socketless test session sends no item queries, so each counted response, selected by its leading item id, comes from the grant. Requires Ascension.Manastorm.Enable = 1.

steps.label: Endless Manastorm Potion responses before entry
The native enter request reached a Manastorm instance
Endless Manastorm Potion is granted on entry
Endless Manastorm Potion's query response is sent with the grant
Regeneration Matrix is granted on entry
Regeneration Matrix's query response is sent with the grant
Magical Escape is granted on entry
Magical Escape's query response is sent with the grant
The leave request returned to the open world
